ESP_PLATFORM.reason: twai_port_ll.h stops a compile that sets TWAI_PORT_HOST_SWITCH with #error when it is defined; ESP-IDF defines it in every ESP-IDF build

IDF_TARGET.reason: CMakeLists.txt picks T8's register file by chip: twai_port_ll_esp32c3.c on the C3, twai_port_ll_esp32s3.c on the S3, twai_port_ll_unsupported.c elsewhere; ESP-IDF sets it from the board's target, which R21 checks

RTC_NOINIT_ATTR.reason: ESP-IDF's esp_attr.h defines it (the T19 stall record's section, twai_port_ll_esp32s3.c); the file defines it empty only for a host build whose esp_attr.h lacks it, never under ESP_PLATFORM

S3_SUPPORTED.reason: twai_port_ll_esp32s3.c defines it itself, 1 when TWAI_PORT_S3_PROBE is set and 0 otherwise, and its #if blocks hold the T19 stall record and the S3 probe mark; TWAI_PORT_S3_PROBE's row refuses what they add

TWAI_PORT_HOST_SWITCH.reason: the testers' host builds on the T10 fake only: twai_port_ll_esp32s3.c reports the kept-driver switch (T14) supported before T19's measurement, so the port's switch runs on the fake. CMakeLists.txt stops any ESP-IDF build that sets it (FATAL_ERROR) and twai_port_ll.h stops the compile (#error under ESP_PLATFORM), so no image can carry it and it needs no image row (charge-interposer reviewer, 2026-11-27). VERIFICATION.md records an ESP-IDF configure refused with it set
TWAI_PORT_HOST_SWITCH.kind: host-test-only define, refused by every ESP-IDF build

TWAI_PORT_S3_PROBE.reason: T19's measurement build for the X2 (the s3probe variant): twai_port_ll_esp32s3.c reports T8, T12 and the kept-driver switch supported before the measurement has passed; with TWAI_PORT_TXABORT_PROBE on the S3 it also compiles the T19 serial app (test_app/twai_port_t19*.c). The rows: the implementor's mark twai_port_s3_probe_build, defined only under this switch (b2240441), the app's entry points twai_port_t19_init and twai_port_t19_line, and three strings only the app has: two of its command names and its refusal of an unknown command (e33430ed)

bin_strings_absent: unknown command; the commands are info

TWAI_PORT_TXABORT_PROBE.reason: T13's transmit-abort measurement build: CMakeLists.txt adds test_app/twai_port_txabort_probe.c, which writes the abort command register from outside the driver and gives the answer (its "probe" string), and test_app/twai_port_txabort_http.c, which answers at /gi_txabort (txab_handler, txab_uri, twai_port_txabort_register), which a project registers from its URI hook; split in a7674f0b, the strings and symbols unchanged. The symbols row also names twai_port_txabort_run, the split's entry point in twai_port_txabort_probe.c that the URI and T19's serial app both call: an image without the URI, such as s3probe, defines it but not the URI's symbols, so the row fails there too (charge-interposer reviewer, 2026-11-27)
